title: tc-team-flag-picker
description: Picks one of a team's flags for a file.

flags.description: The team's flags, in the order they're offered

value.description: The id of the file's flag, or null for none. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

fileName.description: The file's name, so the control says which file it's for

manageable.description: Show a link to the team's flags at the foot of the list, for people who may edit them

disabled.description: Show the flag without letting it change

label.description: The flag's name, shown beside it wherever it's used

meaning.description: What the flag means, so everyone uses it the same way

TeamFlag.description: A flag a team has defined: its colour and what it means
